prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength through weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4 meals spread throughout the day with clear timing
Each meal specifies protein content with minimum 30g per meal
Includes pre-workout and post-workout meal recommendations aligned with training
Total daily calories and macronutrient breakdown provided for strength athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein intake and meal timing around workouts

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Emphasizes carbohydrate-rich foods appropriate for endurance athlete (target ~7-10g carbs per kg body weight)
Includes calorie-dense meals totaling approximately 3,500-4,000 calories for a 70kg marathon runner
Presented in compact, concise format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring calorie-dense meals and carbohydrate loading strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: Match day performance and recovery for professional football

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus pre/post-match nutrition for a single day
All foods are plant-based with no animal products
Includes adequate protein (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight) from plant sources
Contains carbohydrates timed appropriately for football performance and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary restriction (vegan footballer) combining performance nutrition with plant-based food constraints
